text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > mhd_llm/codex/external_model/athena_ct_validation/report.txt <<'EOF'
Athena++ CT fallback: bounded implementation and validation
Author: Codex-external_model
Status: frozen base implemented and bounded gates passed; no full25-day run.

Independent native solver and changes

The numerical dependency is PrincetonUniversity/athena commit
 e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952, copied into its own
 /tmp/x3i-codex-athena-ct/athena-e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952.
Existing hydro and reference checkouts and all production CPU/CUDA sources were
preserved. solver/athena_ct/frozen_base.json records source/executable hashes.
Native Athena supplies double-precision HLLD, PLM reconstruction, spherical
geometry/source terms, SSPRK2 and staggered constrained transport. Own code is
x3i_ct.cpp, surface_driver.hpp and a literal extraction of the frozen postreject
Config/Boundary/units parser (only PI renamed XPI to avoid Athena's macro).
The speed offset -> optional n=C/v^2,T=Dv^2 -> density/temperature scaling order
is unchanged. No cone injection is enabled; nonempty cme_boundary_csv is rejected.
The existing source-centered electric-field CSV is not double-applied: the new
consumer-grid curl solve determines total edge E from the same Br/scalar driver.

Two visible isolated core patches exist. core_hooks.patch adds a callback before
flux reconstruction to cache the full timestep's prescribed E and fill inner
ghosts, a passive flux/source/work observer after reconstruction, and an edge-E
callback after ComputeCornerE and before native CT. strict_floors.patch throws
before every density/pressure/energy floor site in adiabatic_mhd.cpp, including
reconstructed states. Positive above-floor states and native fluxes are unchanged.
No magnetic-energy repair, cell clipping, normal-face resetting, or cleaning
source is added. The first floor activation aborts; successful receipts record0.

Magnetic driving and exact discrete geometry

The target Br is the exact angular area average of the parser's piecewise-linear
latitude/periodic-longitude map at the chosen inertial phase and linearly mixed
daily epochs. Latitude integration uses the analytic integral of (a+b*latitude)
cos(latitude); longitude integration splits at every periodic source knot and
integrates each linear segment. Scalars retain the parent point-query semantics.
An auxiliary full-sphere grid uses exactly the consumer's angular spacing, even
when the 3D mesh is a latitude wedge. Its signed l=0 Br mode is subtracted and
recorded; a smooth global surface curl cannot change total signed flux. Maximum
removed mean at1AU is0.001182nT in the early96 pilot and0.000381nT near day24.
This is an explicit minimal-electric-field closure, not an observed or unique E.

For a full-step interval[t,t+h], target normal fields b0,b1 are evaluated. Preserve
the endpoint-average Parker Etheta=-Omega*r*sin(theta)*Br, Ephi=0 on the actual
edges, and solve the remaining curl residual. With theta increasing southward,
 w_j=cos(theta_lo)-cos(theta_hi), dtheta=pi/N, dphi=2pi/M,
 curl(E)_r=[sin(theta_hi)Ephi_hi-sin(theta_lo)Ephi_lo]/(r*w_j)
             -dtheta*(Etheta_east-Etheta_west)/(r*w_j*dphi).
Solve Delta_cons U=r^2*[(b1-b0)/h+curl(Ebase)], with
 Etheta_corr=Dphi(U)/(r*sin(theta_center)), Ephi_corr=-Dtheta(U)/r.
Delta_cons uses sin(theta_face)/[w_j*dtheta] latitude coefficients and longitude
coefficient dtheta/[w_j*sin(theta_center)]. A mixed-radix Cooley-Tukey longitude
FFT and complex tridiagonal latitude solves implement this exact consumer
operator; polar Ephi is zero, longitude is periodic, and the constant potential
mode is fixed by one-row gauge after signed-mean removal.

The same interval-average total E is used in BOTH SSPRK2 stages. Stage observers
check the actual RHS times t,t+h and normal fields b0,b1. Native CT therefore
advances the active normal faces to b1 algebraically, including intervals crossing
daily map knots. Ghost callbacks never overwrite those faces. Tangential ghost
fields use Bphi=Etheta/vr,Btheta=-Ephi/vr on their native faces. Ghost normal fluxes
are continued recursively from the evolving active face with zero integrated
cell divergence. The initial angular radial flux is identical at every radial
face with Bt=0, hence initially solenoidal. It is deliberately unretarded and
untwisted; a full wind simulation must flush/check this initial assumption.
Outer real-wind boundary is native copied outflow, while analytic geometry modes
use exact exterior continuation. Latitude ghosts also preserve active normal faces.

Gates and quantitative results

geometry_and_manufactured.json contains independently recomputed integrated-face
incidence divergence from the saved float64 face arrays, native observers, exact
stage times, geometry errors and resource receipts. No completed case activated
a floor. Mass and total-MHD-energy budgets include the native gravity energy
source and native conservative fluxes; all maximum normalized residuals are<8e-17.
These are conservation ledgers, not accuracy proofs.

Uniform Cartesian-B equilibrium,0.1day,24x4x24 and48x8x48 on log radius, wedge+/-30:
point Bz relative L1 errors0.0094457 ->0.00236386 (order1.999). Maximum velocity
0.002325 ->0.00059197km/s. Exact native face-flux divergence is near roundoff;
point/face/volume-center interpolation error explains a finite Bcc truncation.

Radial exact equilibrium uses gamma1.5,v400km/s,n=5/r^2,Br=3/r^2nT,p proportional
r^-3,Omega0 and 3*p0*r0/rho0=GM. For p=2*np*k*Tp at r0=.1AU this requires
Tp0=179122.224473K, not the hot observational calibration. At0.1day24->48:
relative point L1 n4.599e-6 ->1.440e-6 (order1.675), vr2.770e-7 ->6.846e-8
(order2.016),p.0042971 ->.00105929(order2.020),Br.0132105 ->.00329177(order2.005).
Polar velocity L1 is5.706e-6 ->1.459e-6km/s. Fractional steady mass-flux L1 is
3.428e-7 ->8.940e-8. These two-grid short-run rates include initial point versus
native face/volume averaging offsets; they do not establish production convergence.
The single-sign radial field's mathematical monopole is inside the excluded
sphere, outside this computational shell; it is not a physical full-Sun field.

Manufactured rotating+time-varying dipolar boundary,48x8x48,0.2day:45steps,
90stage callbacks. Normal-target error<=1.65e-14 codeB, approximately5e-15 relative;
native face divB<=1.03e-12 codeB/AU. Actual upstream ghost fast Mach>=1.54468.
Native boundary energy minus imposed hydrodynamic flux matches edge-E Poynting
work to4.44e-16 of total boundary energy flux. The standalone surface test spans
multiple epochs and h=1e-5,.001,.02day; max relative curl residual1.25e-11 is
floating subtraction/mean residual, while native stage tracking remains roundoff.

Actual-map48 pilot,day23.95->24.05,log radius,+/-30:46steps,~1.48s wall,~74MBRSS.
It crosses a daily source knot. Stage/end target error1.155e-14codeB,native divB
2.27e-12codeB/AU, actual ghost fast Mach>=1.30680. Integrated native boundary
energy-minus-hydro exceeds imposed CT work using the ACTUAL upstream ghost B by
0.50881%; maximum local discrepancy is0.36355% of total energy flux.

Two additionally authorized UNIFORM radial96x32x96,+/-60 timing pilots:
 day9->9.05:16steps,3.74s totalwall; day23.95->24.00:17steps,3.95s totalwall.
Peak RSS is~257MB, one CPU, nice15, with1GB AS and60s wall caps. Actual ghost fast
Mach minima are1.377494/1.308331. Stage/end target errors1.02e-14/1.33e-14codeB;
native face divB maxima3.50e-13/3.65e-13codeB/AU. Integrated work discrepancies
are0.104710%/0.096967% of CT work; maximum local discrepancies0.131135%/0.151722%
of total energy flux. Native HLLD energy flux agrees with its physical upstream
state to<7e-16. Thus remaining imposed-work mismatch is finite edge/ghost angular
interpolation, not a hidden conservation-ledger defect. No work correction was
applied. The nominal E/v-center observer is also retained separately and must not
be confused with the actual-ghost observer. These short untwisted pilots do not
establish long-run stability, thermal fidelity, or all-epoch superfast inflow.

A linear short-pilot wall extrapolation suggests~1870..1975s for25days at this96
grid before output-only optimization. Later characteristic speeds, nonlinear
structures and I/O can change this substantially; it is no runtime upper bound.
RUSAGE_CHILDREN CPU/high-water fields in the old runner are not authoritative
per-process resource accounting. Use elapsed wall here; the production controller
will use /usr/bin/time -v as the per-process CPU/RSS source.

Receipt/config corrections and limitations

The first real48 run inherited inactive parent run.cfg numerical keys, while its
actual athinput and saved axes correctly used log radius,+/-30,CFL.25. This was a
metadata mismatch. Legacy configs/native inputs/receipts were archived; canonical
configs now match every actual setting and list inactive parent flags separately.
All six cheap gates were rerun and every one of their10 state/axis/face arrays was
byte-identical. The passive actual-ghost/stage diagnostic extension was also
qualified by byte identity of all eight cases. No old run was relabeled as having
used the corrected config. Canonical controller generation will guard agreement.

The deliberate pressure-floor negative gate detects the first pre-floor abort.
Pinned Athena prints this initialization exception but returns zero. Own runner
therefore archives any prior completion marker before launching and requires a
new completed statistics marker; incomplete native-zero execution becomes code86.
This also avoids relying on WSL/Windows file modification-time alignment.

Final outputs include compatible probe.csv and snapshot_00000.npy[nr,ntheta,nphi,8]
fields n,vr,vtheta,vphi,p,Br,Btheta,Bphi, float64 axes and exact staggered face arrays.
Native Athena centers are volume-weighted, not local-solver midpoints. Existing
solver/audit_sparse_divergence.py presently rejects those coordinates even in its
stored-axis mode; do not silently reinterpret them. The independent native face
incidence audit supplied here is valid. A later centered-field audit needs an
explicit native-geometry reader. CT face divergence and centered interpolated
field derivative are distinct diagnostics. No full25day run/movie was started.
No convergence, CME forecast, unique electric closure or observational validation
is claimed by these implementation gates.

Primary numerical source anchors
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/tree/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/blob/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952/src/field/ct.cpp
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/blob/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952/src/field/field.cpp
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/blob/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952/src/task_list/time_integrator.cpp
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/blob/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952/src/coordinates/spherical_polar.cpp
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/blob/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952/src/hydro/srcterms/pointmass.cpp
https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena/blob/e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952/src/eos/adiabatic_mhd.cpp
EOF
cat > mhd_llm/codex/solver/athena_ct/README.md <<'EOF'
